name: Austria
description: Austria from Hallstatt and the Habsburgs to Mozart's Vienna, the empire of Austria-Hungary, the world wars and the neutral republic.

checkpoints.name: Alpine peoples
checkpoints.note: Ötzi died in the mountains more than five thousand years ago. The salt miners of Hallstatt gave their name to an Iron Age, and Rome held the Danube frontier.

checkpoints.name: The Habsburgs
checkpoints.note: Austria grew into the heart of the Habsburg lands. Vienna held off the Ottomans in 1529 and 1683, and Haydn and Mozart made it the capital of music.

checkpoints.name: Austria-Hungary
checkpoints.note: The dual monarchy ruled much of Central Europe. Vienna was the city of Freud and Klimt, until the killing in Sarajevo in 1914 led to war and collapse.

checkpoints.name: The republic
checkpoints.note: A small republic was left in 1918. Hitler annexed it in 1938, and after the war Austria was occupied until the treaty of 1955 made it free and neutral.
